text: My ease, my domestic happiness, my rural pleasures, my little property, my personal liberty, my reputation, my life, have little weight and ever had in my own estimation, in comparison with the great object of my country.
author: John Adams
reference: Familiar Letters of John Adams and His Wife Abigail Adams
locator: Letter 89, John Adams to Abigail Adams, Philadelphia, 19 March, 1776
